_note: Approved copy edits and the NFL card markers, applied to the main site's files at build time. Each is idempotent: if the new text is already present the edit is skipped. If neither old nor new text is found the build fails, so a page rewritten elsewhere is noticed instead of silently left half-edited. Once the live site is imported into site/, these can be folded into the files themselves.
